# Ezekiel 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-He-called in-my-ears [with a]-voice great, saying, "Draw-near, [you]-punishments-of the-city, and-each his-weapon-of destruction in-his-hand."

**2** And-behold, six men coming from-[the]-direction-of the-gate, the-upper, which faces north, and-each his-weapon-of shattering in-his-hand; and-one man in-their-midst [was] clothed-in linen, and-[the]-case-of [the]-scribe's-ink at-his-waist; and-they-came and-stood beside the-altar-of bronze.

**3** And-the-glory-of the-God-of Israel went-up from-upon the-cherub on-which it-was, to the-threshold-of the-house; and-He-called to the-man clothed-in the-linen, who [had the]-case-of the-scribe's-ink at-his-waist.

**4** And-YHWH said to-him, "Pass through-the-midst-of the-city, through-the-midst-of Jerusalem, and-mark a-mark upon the-foreheads-of the-men, the-ones-groaning and-the-ones-sighing over all the-abominations which-are-done in-her-midst."

**5** And-to-the-others He-said in-my-hearing, "Pass through the-city after-him and-strike. Let-not your-eye spare, and-do-not-have-pity.

**6** Old-man, young-man and-virgin, and-children and-women, you-shall-kill to-destruction; but-upon every man who-has upon-him the-mark, do-not-draw-near. And-from-My-sanctuary you-shall-begin." And-they-began with-the-men, the-elders, who [were] before the-house.

**7** And-He-said to-them, "Defile the-house and-fill the-courts [with]-the-slain. Go-out!" And-they-went-out and-struck in-the-city.

**8** And-it-was as-they-struck, and-I [was]-left — and-I-fell upon my-face and-cried-out and-said, "Ah, Lord YHWH! Are-You destroying all the-remnant-of Israel in-Your-pouring-out Your-fury upon Jerusalem?"

**9** And-He-said to-me, "The-iniquity-of the-house-of Israel and-Judah [is] great, exceedingly, exceedingly, and-the-land is-filled [with]-blood, and-the-city is-full-of perversion; for they-say, 'YHWH has-forsaken the-land, and-YHWH does-not-see.'

**10** And-I also — My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I-will-not-have-pity; their-way upon-their-head I-have-put."

**11** And-behold, the-man clothed-in the-linen, who [had] the-case-of-ink at-his-waist, brought-back word, saying, "I-have-done as all-that You-commanded-me."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **9:4**: Ve-hitavita tav — 'and mark a mark (tav).' The letter tav, last in the Hebrew alphabet, was written as an X or + in ancient script. The marked are those who mourn over abominations — grief becomes a mark of salvation.

- **9:3**: The glory rising from the cherub to the threshold begins the departure sequence that culminates in chapters 10-11. YHWH leaves His own house by stages.

- **9:6**: U-mi-miqdashi tachelu — 'and from My sanctuary you shall begin.' Judgment begins at God's house (cf. 1 Pet 4:17). The elders who defiled the Temple are struck first.

— EMET
